Mit „Leberwerten“ sind drei Gruppen geme: “Liver values” means three groups. GOT and GPT (AST and ALT) come from the liver cells: they rise when cells are irritated or damaged.
GGT und AP sitzen an den Gallengängen. S: GGT and AP (ALP) are found at the bile ducts. They rise mainly when bile does not drain well – or because of alcohol and medication.
Albumin, Gerinnung und Cholinesterase ze: Albumin, clotting and cholinesterase show what the liver can still do. They only become abnormal in a severe liver disease.
Erhöhte Werte sind häufig und meist harm: Raised values are common and usually harmless. Only the pattern together with an ultrasound and your history gives a picture.
Die GPT (auch ALT) steckt fast nur in de: GPT (also called ALT) is found almost only in the liver. It is the best value for irritated liver cells. Roughly normal: women under 35, men under 50 U/l, depending on the laboratory.
Die GOT (auch AST) steckt auch in Muskel: GOT (also called AST) is also found in muscles and in the heart. After hard exercise or a muscle injury it can rise even though the liver is healthy. The limits are similar to those of GPT.
Meist ist die GPT höher als die GOT, etw: Usually GPT is higher than GOT, for example with a fatty liver. If GOT is clearly higher, we think more of alcohol or a scarred liver.
Ein Anstieg auf das Doppelte ist häufig: A rise to double the limit is common and often temporary. Values above ten times the limit point to an acute liver inflammation, for example from viruses or medication.
Die GGT ist der empfindlichste Leberwert: GGT is the most sensitive liver value – it reacts even to small irritations. Roughly normal: women under 40, men under 60 U/l, depending on the laboratory.
Sie steigt durch Alkohol, auch durch reg: It rises with alcohol, even regular small amounts, with a fatty liver and with some medications, for example against seizures.
Staut sich die Galle, steigt die GGT zus: If bile backs up, GGT rises together with AP (ALP).
Ist nur die GGT leicht erhöht und alles: If only GGT is slightly raised and everything else is normal, this is usually harmless. A few weeks without alcohol often show where it comes from.
Die alkalische Phosphatase (AP) steigt,: Alkaline phosphatase (AP, ALP) rises when bile does not drain, for example because of a gallstone. But it also comes from the bones – in growing children and after bone fractures it is normally raised.
Bilirubin entsteht, wenn alte rote Blutk: Bilirubin is produced when old red blood cells are broken down. The liver releases it into the bile, and it colors the stool brown. Roughly normal is total bilirubin below 1.2 mg/dl.
Staut es sich, werden Augen und Haut gel: If it backs up, the eyes and skin turn yellow, the urine becomes dark and the stool light – this must be checked quickly.
Häufig und harmlos ist das Gilbert-Meule: Gilbert-Meulengracht syndrome is common and harmless: about one in twenty people breaks down bilirubin a little more slowly. It rises slightly during fasting or infections, otherwise nothing happens.
Was die Leber noch schafft: What the liver can still do
Die Leber stellt wichtige Eiweiße her. D: The liver produces important proteins. These values do not show irritation but function – they only fall when a large part of the liver no longer works.
Albumin ist das häufigste Eiweiß im Blut: Albumin is the most common protein in the blood and keeps water in the vessels. If it is too low, the legs and abdomen swell.
Quick und INR zeigen, wie gut das Blut g: Quick and INR show how well the blood clots, because the clotting factors come from the liver. People who take blood thinners such as Marcumar have deliberately altered values.
Auch die Cholinesterase sinkt, wenn die: Cholinesterase also falls when the liver becomes weaker. Together these values help assess liver cirrhosis.
Leicht erhöhte Werte kontrollieren wir m: We usually recheck slightly raised values after a few weeks. Until then, a break from alcohol helps.
Wir gehen Ihre Medikamente, Schmerzmitte: We go through your medications, painkillers and supplements – herbal remedies can also irritate the liver.
Bleiben die Werte erhöht, folgen ein Ult: If the values stay raised, an ultrasound and a blood test for hepatitis viruses follow, sometimes for iron and other causes.
Am häufigsten steckt eine Fettleber dahi: Most often a fatty liver is behind it. Then losing weight lowers the values best.
Ein einzelner erhöhter Leberwert ist häu: A single raised liver value is common and no reason to worry. But yellow eyes, dark urine or light stool should be checked quickly.
Die Nieren filtern jeden Tag das gesamte: Every day the kidneys filter all of the blood many times. Waste products and excess water go into the urine, valuable things like protein stay in the blood.
Zwei Fragen sind wichtig: Wie viel filte: Two questions are important: How much do the kidneys still filter? Creatinine and eGFR in the blood show this.
Und ist der Filter dicht? Das zeigt das: And is the filter tight? The protein albumin in the urine shows this.
Beide zusammen sagen mehr als jeder Wert: Both together say more than either value alone – and the trend more than a single measurement.
Kreatinin ist ein Abfallstoff der Muskel: Creatinine is a waste product of the muscles. It is produced steadily and is excreted almost only through the kidneys. Roughly normal: women up to 0.9, men up to 1.2 mg/dl, depending on the laboratory.
Wer viele Muskeln hat, hat mehr Kreatini: People with a lot of muscle have more creatinine. Also a lot of meat the day before, hard exercise and creatine powder push the value up – without the kidney being ill.
Bei sehr schlanken und älteren Menschen: In very slim and older people the value is often low and falsely suggests a good kidney.
Kreatinin steigt erst spät: Oft hat die: Creatinine rises only late: often the kidney has already lost almost half of its function before the value climbs above the limit. That is why we calculate the eGFR.
Die eGFR schätzt, wie viel Blut die Nier: The eGFR estimates how much blood the kidneys filter per minute. The laboratory calculates it from creatinine, age and sex, usually with the CKD-EPI formula. The unit ml/min/1.73 m² converts to an average body size.
Ab 90 ist normal, 60 bis 89 leicht einge: From 90 upwards is normal, 60 to 89 is mildly reduced – in older age this is often still normal. From 45 to 59 function is moderately reduced, from 30 to 44 clearly reduced.
Unter 30 ist die Niere stark geschwächt,: Below 30 the kidney is severely weakened, below 15 it fails; then dialysis or transplantation come into question.
Erst wenn die eGFR über drei Monate unte: Only when the eGFR stays below 60 for more than three months do we speak of chronic kidney disease.
Ein gesunder Nierenfilter hält das Eiwei: A healthy kidney filter keeps the protein albumin in the blood. Even small amounts in the urine show that the filter is becoming leaky – often years before the eGFR falls.
Gemessen wird im Morgenurin, als Verhält: It is measured in morning urine, as the ratio of albumin to creatinine. Normal is below 30 mg/g; 30 to 300 is moderately raised, above that strongly raised.
Besonders bei Diabetes und Bluthochdruck: Especially with diabetes and high blood pressure we check this once a year. Protein in the urine also means a higher risk for the heart and blood vessels.
Sport, Fieber, ein Harnwegsinfekt oder d: Exercise, fever, a urinary tract infection or menstrual bleeding raise the value briefly. That is why a raised value only counts if it appears in two of three samples.
Cystatin C ist ein zweiter Filterwert, d: Cystatin C is a second filtration value that does not depend on the muscles. We use it when creatinine could be misleading, for example in very muscular, very slim or older people.
Harnstoff steigt durch viel Eiweiß im Es: Urea rises with a lot of protein in the diet and with too little drinking. On its own it says little about the kidney.
Kalium, grob 3,5 bis 5,0 mmol/l, muss di: Potassium, roughly 3.5 to 5.0 mmol/l, has to be excreted by the kidney. Some blood pressure medications and a weak kidney raise it – too much disturbs the heart rhythm.
Ist Kalium unerwartet hoch, war es oft n: If potassium is unexpectedly high, it was often just the sample tube: long standing or pumping with the fist during the blood draw releases potassium from the blood cells. Then we measure again.
Am meisten schützt ein gut eingestellter: What protects the most is well-controlled blood pressure and blood sugar.
Schmerzmittel wie Ibuprofen, Diclofenac: Do not take painkillers such as ibuprofen, diclofenac or naproxen permanently. Drink normally according to thirst, about one and a half liters.
Bei schwächerer Niere passen wir die Dos: With a weaker kidney we adjust the dose of many medications. Please tell us before an X-ray or CT scan with contrast agent.
Manche Medikamente schützen die Niere zu: Some medications additionally protect the kidney, for example certain blood pressure medications or so-called SGLT2 inhibitors. We will discuss whether they suit you.
Wichtiger als ein einzelner Wert ist der: More important than a single value is the trend – together with the protein in the urine. With every new doctor and medication, say: “My kidneys are weaker.”
Fett im Blut braucht Taxis: Fat in the blood needs taxis
Cholesterin ist lebenswichtig: Der Körpe: Cholesterol is vital: the body uses it to build cell walls, hormones and bile. The liver makes most of it itself.
Fett löst sich nicht im Blut. Es fährt d: Fat does not dissolve in blood. It therefore travels in small protein taxis, the lipoproteins.
Das LDL bringt Cholesterin von der Leber: LDL carries cholesterol from the liver to the body – too much of it is deposited in the vessel walls. HDL brings excess cholesterol back to the liver.
Das Gesamtcholesterin allein sagt deshal: Total cholesterol alone therefore says little. What matters is which taxis it travels in.
LDL – das Cholesterin, das sich ablagert: LDL – the cholesterol that gets deposited
Je mehr LDL über die Jahre im Blut ist,: The more LDL is in the blood over the years, the more is deposited in the arteries. This is the most important blood fat value.
Einen festen Normwert gibt es nicht – da: There is no fixed normal value – the target depends on your risk. In healthy people roughly below 115 mg/dl, with moderate risk below 100, with high risk below 70.
Nach Herzinfarkt oder Schlaganfall und b: After a heart attack or stroke and with very high risk, below 55 applies. With LDL there is no such thing as too low.
Liegt das LDL über 190, ist es oft erbli: If LDL is above 190, it is often hereditary. Then we also look at parents, siblings and children.
Das HDL sammelt überschüssiges Cholester: HDL collects excess cholesterol and brings it back to the liver. A higher value is usually favorable: roughly above 40 mg/dl in men, above 50 in women.
